<!-- Search existing issues before submitting. Keep each request focused on one improvement. -->

## Problem or use case

What are you trying to do, and how does AniRewind currently fall short? Describe who would benefit and when.

## Proposed solution

Describe how the feature should work from a user's perspective. Include an example if helpful.

## Area of the app

<!-- Keep the relevant items or describe another area. -->

- AniList username lookup and data
- Rewatch counts and summary statistics
- Rankings, sorting, or anime links
- Layout, accessibility, or themes
- Other:

## What would success look like?

Describe the observable behavior that would make this request complete.

## Alternatives considered (optional)

Describe other approaches or workarounds you have tried.

## Additional context (optional)

Include mockups, screenshots, or example inputs and outputs. If the feature needs additional AniList data, describe what is needed.

<!-- AniRewind currently reads public anime lists directly from AniList without sign-in.
If your proposal changes that workflow, explain the intended user experience. -->
